# ssh-docker-host

A docker engine on another machine, reached over SSH and tunnelled back to this one.

<!-- Generated by nix build .#referencePages -->

## Inputs

| input | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| address | string | *(required)* | Where the host is, as `ssh` dials it. Required. |
| user | null or string | `null` | Who to log in as. Null leaves it to the operator's SSH config, which is the place to say it once for every lab on that host.  |

## Provides

| provision | signature | what it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| host | [CONTAINER_HOST](../signatures/CONTAINER_HOST.md) | A docker engine the lab places clusters and host services on, as `cata` reaches it. |

## What it emits

Rendered by `minimal.remote` as the lab unit `host`. A unit of the lab
installs nothing into a cluster, and its provisions are sealed inside the
lab's inclusion — so its declaration above is its interface.
